Team — quick tech readout after initial logs and profiler:
- Errors: most 502s are from grpc timeouts in the aggregator layer when the decoder stage sees long-tail token expansion for certain prompts (samples attached).
- Latency: p99 jumps correlate with longer decode loops when beam/temperature combos trigger longer generations; q4_bert appears to add variability in KV cache eviction behavior under our batching strategy.
- Quality drift: a small subset of prompts show hallucination patterns likely from subtle tokenization changes in the v5.2 tokenizer patch, not purely quantization.

Mitigation options (pros/cons):
A) Immediate rollback to v5.1 + q8_mix: fast (30–45m), restores baseline performance but misses some v5.2 quality fixes.
B) Adjust runtime batching & lower max_decode_steps for Boreas only: risky, may reduce throughput for valid long requests.
C) Hotfix tokenizer patch + rolling small-batch deployment: medium risk, 2–3 hours to validate.

Recommendation: execute A (rollback tenant to v5.1/q8_mix) to stop customer impact, then schedule RCA (we need to confirm tokenizer delta and decoder loop interactions). I can own the post-mortem.

Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
